snippet.title: Shepherd Knight - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Shepherd Knight will release on June 4th, 2026!
Add it to your Steam Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700790/Shepherd_Knight/

Prepare yourself for a journey where strategy and courage walk hand in hand. Alongside your faithful dog, you will face ancient dangers to lead your magical flock to safety.
